svg.title: Full length-wise retention-cap re-evaluation
svg.desc: Untouched and one-head capped NoPE, Polar, and RoPE checkpoints across retrieval, BABILong, and long-document likelihood from 2K through 256K.
svg.text: Recovery appears across lengths, not only at 256K
Dashed/open = matched untouched · solid/filled = one-head cap · dotted/filled = untouched Raven reference
Raven Native and Atma-Raven-Titans remain untouched references. The cap is a checkpoint probe applied only to the three matched attention variants.
